data.name: AdminAddCommand
data.value: add an administrator and show their password

data.name: AdminCommand
data.value: who signs in to the panel and at which address it opens

data.name: AdminLoginArgument
data.value: login: Latin letters, digits, dot, hyphen, underscore

data.name: AdminNewOption
data.value: replace the panel address with a new random one

data.name: AdminPasswordCommand
data.value: issue a new password, end previous sessions and lift the lockout

data.name: AdminPasswordReset
data.value: Password of administrator “{0}” replaced, previous sessions ended

data.name: AdminPathCommand
data.value: show the panel address; --new replaces it

data.name: ApiKeyAddCommand
data.value: issue a key and show it

data.name: ApiKeyCommand
data.value: REST API keys; the API and Swagger UI live under the panel address

data.name: ApiKeyNameArgument
data.value: name: Latin letters, digits, dot, hyphen, underscore

data.name: ApiKeyRemoveCommand
data.value: revoke a key; requests with it get 401 right away

data.name: ApiKeyShownOnce
data.value: The key is shown once. A lost key cannot be recovered: remove it and issue a new one.

data.name: BackupCommand
data.value: consistent copy of the database and keys; the service can keep running

data.name: BackupDirectoryArgument
data.value: new or empty directory for the copy

data.name: BackupTargetNotEmpty
data.value: directory {0} is not empty, a new or empty one is needed

data.name: ClientAddCommand
data.value: issue a client and show the token

data.name: ClientCommand
data.value: who has access, until when and with which limits

data.name: ClientConcurrencyOption
data.value: concurrent requests; none removes the limit

data.name: ClientDisableCommand
data.value: close access without removing the client

data.name: ClientExpiresOption
data.value: date YYYY-MM-DD (UTC) from which access is closed; never removes the expiry

data.name: ClientMetaOption
data.value: metadata key=value for the upstream, can be repeated

data.name: ClientNameArgument
data.value: client name; quote it if it has spaces

data.name: ClientQuotaOption
data.value: tools/call calls per period; none removes the quota

data.name: ClientRateOption
data.value: requests per minute; none removes the limit

data.name: ClientReissueCommand
data.value: issue a new token; the old one stops working

data.name: ClientResetCommand
data.value: reset the quota counter and start a new period

data.name: ClientResetDaysOption
data.value: days until the quota resets; none cancels resets

data.name: ClientSetCommand
data.value: change the expiry, limits or inbounds

data.name: ClientShowCommand
data.value: show the token and connection addresses

data.name: ExpiryInvalid
data.value: date “{0}” not understood: use YYYY-MM-DD, for example 2027-07-01, or {1}

data.name: InboundAddCommand
data.value: add an inbound for a remote MCP server

data.name: InboundDisableCommand
data.value: disable an inbound without removing it

data.name: InboundHeaderOption
data.value: header for the upstream: Name=value, can be repeated

data.name: InboundIdentityOption
data.value: send X-Mcp-Client-* and X-Mcp-Meta-* headers to the upstream

data.name: InboundNameOption
data.value: name shown in lists, the slug by default

data.name: InboundRemoveCommand
data.value: remove an inbound and every client's access to it

data.name: LimitInvalid
data.value: {0}: “{1}” does not fit, use a whole number or {2} to remove the limit

data.name: NoAdmins
data.value: No admins, nobody can sign in to the panel. Add one: ctx-ui admin add <login>

data.name: NoApiKeys
data.value: No keys. Issue one: ctx-ui apikey add <name>

data.name: NumberInRange
data.value: {0}: a number from 1 to {1} is needed

data.name: PanelPathRenewed
data.value: The new address works after the service restarts; until then the old one stays

data.name: PasswordShownOnce
data.value: The password is shown once. If it is lost, issue a new one: ctx-ui admin password <login>

data.name: QuotaReset
data.value: Quota counter of client “{0}” reset, a new period has started

data.name: RootDescription
data.value: ctx-ui: inbounds, clients, call accounting, panel sign-in and API keys

data.name: TokenLost
data.value: Token: cannot be shown: the stored copy cannot be decrypted, the keys directory is lost.

data.name: TokenLostApi
data.value: The token cannot be shown: the stored copy cannot be decrypted, the keys directory is lost. Issue a new one: POST …/reissue

data.name: TokenLostHint
data.value: Issue a new one: ctx-ui client reissue "{0}"

data.name: UsageCommand
data.value: what was called and how much; times in UTC

data.name: UsageDay
data.value: {0} calls {1}, tools/call {2}, upstream failures {3}, gateway refusals {4}, average {5} ms

data.name: UsageDaysOption
data.value: how many recent days, 7 by default

data.name: UsageLimitOption
data.value: how many recent lines, 50 by default

data.name: OAuthStatusCommand
data.value: show the OAuth settings and providers

data.name: OAuthKeyOnCommand
data.value: allow signing in with a key

data.name: OAuthKeyOffCommand
data.value: forbid signing in with a key

data.name: ProviderSetCommand
data.value: add a provider or change its settings

data.name: ProviderRemoveCommand
data.value: remove a provider and the accounts linked through it

data.name: ProviderNameArgument
data.value: provider: google, microsoft, github, gitlab, yandex, vkid, discord, telegram or oidc

data.name: ProviderClientIdOption
data.value: client ID issued by the provider

data.name: ProviderSecretStdinOption
data.value: read the client secret from the standard input

data.name: ClientDevicesOption
data.value: device limit: a number (and none in set)

data.name: ClientDirectKeyOption
data.value: a permanent key works: on or off

data.name: ClientDevicesCommand
data.value: list the devices of a client

data.name: ClientDeviceOffCommand
data.value: disconnect a device by id or prefix, or all of them

data.name: ClientInviteCommand
data.value: issue a link that binds an outside account to the client

data.name: ClientLinksCommand
data.value: list accounts linked to a client

data.name: ClientUnlinkCommand
data.value: unlink the accounts of a provider from a client

data.name: DeviceIdArgument
data.value: device id or its first characters

data.name: OAuthIdleDays
data.value: Days without use before a device is disconnected: {0}

data.name: OAuthSelfRevoke
data.value: A client can disconnect its devices: {0}

data.name: OAuthOffWarning
data.value: Warning: clients without a permanent key: {0}. They lose access while OAuth is off.

data.name: KeySignInOnDone
data.value: Sign in with a key is on

data.name: KeySignInOffDone
data.value: Sign in with a key is off

data.name: SecretEmpty
data.value: the secret from the standard input is empty

data.name: DeviceReason_TokenReused
data.value: disconnected: a used token was presented again

data.name: DeviceReason_Idle
data.value: disconnected: not used for too long

data.name: DeviceNoMatch
data.value: no device of the client starts with {0}

data.name: DeviceAmbiguous
data.value: several devices start with {0}, give more characters

data.name: DefaultDevicesInvalid
data.value: defaultMaxDevices: expected a number or none, got {0}
